bio: Situated within a palazzo full of history, from the medieval basement to the Renaissance-style architecture of the restaurant itself, Locale is accessed via an old courtyard with a lounge bar and large cocktail counter, from which you make your way to the beautiful rooms to the rear of the building. Here, you’ll enjoy creative, innovative cuisine with personalised touches influenced by the chef’s professional experience around the world in countries such as Australia, Japan and France. Don’t miss the short tour of the building led by the restaurant staff, which includes the extraordinary basement rooms dating from the 13C....
